inputMethod: Actual handleRequest/publication functions from pinned product archive; real Node SQLite schema+migration+triggers; synthetic normal create then historical writer-shaped SQL state; current protected GET DTOs, status/delete receipts
privateCoordinateNotice: All coordinates are synthetic; no operating API or real reports are read.
sqlReadSelections:
SELECT id, species, bird_count, status, public_lat, public_lon, location_hidden, nickname, note,
                 CASE WHEN public_lat IS NOT NULL AND public_lon IS NOT NULL
                   AND (public_lat <> lat OR public_lon <> lon) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS public_point_masked,
                 created_at, updated_at, last_confirmed_at, last_activity_at, user_hash, CAST(row_revision AS TEXT) AS row_revision FROM field_updates WHERE id = ?1

SELECT epoch,CAST(revision AS TEXT) AS revision,typeof(revision) AS revision_type,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type='trigger' AND name IN (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)) AS guards
 FROM public_publication_state WHERE id=1

SELECT id, species, bird_count, status, public_lat, public_lon, location_hidden, nickname, note,
                 CASE WHEN public_lat IS NOT NULL AND public_lon IS NOT NULL
                   AND (public_lat <> lat OR public_lon <> lon) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS public_point_masked,
                 created_at, updated_at, last_confirmed_at, last_activity_at, user_hash, CAST(row_revision AS TEXT) AS row_revision FROM field_updates WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM field_updates WHERE last_activity_at>=?1 AND status<>'deleted' ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC

SELECT field_update_id,status,nickname,created_at FROM field_update_events WHERE field_update_id IN (SELECT id FROM field_updates WHERE last_activity_at>=?1 AND status<>'deleted' ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC LIMIT 100) ORDER BY created_at ASC,rowid ASC

SELECT field_update_id,COUNT(*) AS n FROM field_update_confirmations WHERE field_update_id IN (SELECT id FROM field_updates WHERE last_activity_at>=?1 AND status<>'deleted' ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC LIMIT 100) GROUP BY field_update_id
